subject: Staggered NIC/IO Path Firmware Refresh — customer-facing notice
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbithealth.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 08:12:00 -0400
Subject: Planned: NIC/IO path firmware refresh (staggered windows) — Aug 28-29

Hi Lena —

Following up from our reliability review, we have a scheduled firmware refresh across a subset of NICs and IO-path firmware that will improve packet handling and reduce transient stalls during heavy KV-cache churn. We expect this to reduce token-tail latency on long-context requests by ~6-8% based on canary results.

High-level plan:
- What: NIC and IO-path firmware refresh (non-disruptive in most cases, requires brief rolling restarts)
- When: Aug 28 00:00 UTC — Aug 29 12:00 UTC (staggered across zones to avoid region-wide impact)
- Affected regions: us-east2 (primary), us-west3 (targeted subset)
- Expected customer impact: brief single-node restarts for impacted model workers; typical RTO per node ~90–180s. Will be routed to healthy model variants during restart windows.

We wanted to give OrbitHealth an early heads-up because you ran the large-batch inference workload earlier this month and we can tailor the maintenance window to minimize overlap. Attached is a compatibility matrix and a calendar invite stub.

Action items:
- Please confirm a preferred blackout window if Aug 28–29 conflicts with any scheduled demos or batch jobs.
- If you want us to hold changes for your account and apply only to non-production pools, say so and we'll pin your production pools to the prior firmware for a short grace period.

Thanks — we'll post progress updates in the shared Drive link and send a final reminder 72h and 2h prior to the window.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Senior SRE, Redwood Inference
alex.martinez@redwood.ai

Attachments: 2028-08-14-maintenance-window-calendar.ics (calendar invite stub), firmware-compatibility-matrix.pdf (summary)
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@orbithealth.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex.martinez@redwood.ai>
Cc: ops@orbithealth.com
Date: Tue, 14 Aug 2028 09:03:21 -0400
Subject: Re: Planned: NIC/IO path firmware refresh (staggered windows) — Aug 28-29

Alex —

Thanks for the heads-up. Aug 28 is OK for us in general, though we have a recurring analytics slice that spans 02:00–05:00 UTC. Can you avoid applying the us-east2 window between 02:00–06:00 UTC?

Also two quick asks:
1) If you can keep production model pools on the previous firmware for +72 hours while you observe canaries, we'd prefer that.
2) Please share the specific node tagging you plan to touch so our firewall team can whitelist any temporary monitoring callbacks.

Appreciate you looping us in.

—Lena
Director, Platform Ops | OrbitHealth

Team —

Lena wants: 1) avoid us-east2 02:00–06:00 UTC window; 2) hold production pools on previous firmware for +72h after canary. Also asked for node tags. Proposed plan below:

Proposed adjustments:
- Shift the us-east2 window: start at 06:30 UTC and then apply the standard staggered cadence; us-west3 unaffected by that blackout.
- Canary cadence: run canaries for 6 hours per shard; hold production pin for 72 hours after last successful canary pass (we already have the toggles to pin at account level).
- Node tags: will export a list in the shared Drive link; include node hostnames and pool IDs.

Operational notes:
- Roll is non-blocking; routing policy will send traffic to healthy variants. We'll enable additional KV-cache warming to reduce cold-start token penalty.
- We'll publish a status page update and a short postmortem template after the window; prioritize any customer-facing regressions.

Can Marcus own the final timing comms and the 72h pin toggle? Priyom can you generate the node tag export by EOD?

Alex

Thanks — quick update and confirmation:

- We will shift the us-east2 maintenance to begin Aug 28 at 06:30 UTC (end window still Aug 29 12:00 UTC) to avoid OrbitHealth analytics slice.
- Production pools for OrbitHealth (acct: OrbitHealth-prod) will be pinned to firmware v4.1.2 for 72 hours after canary green; non-prod pools will proceed on the default cadence.
- Priyom: I've added a task in INF-4821 to export the node tags and firewall callback IPs (ETA EOD).
- Communications: We'll send the 72h and 2h reminders and publish the short status note to status.redwood.ai during the operation.

Lena — appreciate the quick reply. Expect the node-tag export link in the shared Drive in the next 6 hours and the calendar invite has been updated.

Regards,
